notes: Context sensitivity, measured rather than assumed: the same route is 0.2902 s/token on a 13-token prompt (27b-t2s2-decode-20261106) and 0.3857 s/token over 106-512-token answers, i.e. ~1.33x - so quoting the short-prompt figure as an end-to-end rate would be wrong by a third. This figure also carries each request's prefill (~60-100 prompt tokens at 19.55 tok/s, a few seconds of the ~127 s per question), which is why it is labelled end-to-end per token rather than a kernel-stream rate.
